2.209.14
Map.MapDistanceScale
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
The Map.MapDistanceScale element specifies the distance scale for a Map. This element is optional.
This element is of type MapDistanceScale.
The following is the parent element of the Map.MapDistanceScale element.
Parent elements
 Map
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Map.MapDistanceScale element.
 <xsd:element name="MapDistanceScale" type="MapDistanceScaleType" minOccurs="0" />
